title: fuzz_raw input
description: Input schema for the fuzz_raw tool (RFC-001 N8 typed raw fuzzer).

flow_id.description: Recorded raw stream id; OPTIONAL — when empty, override_bytes or a 'payload' position must supply the variant bytes.

target_addr.description: Upstream host:port. REQUIRED. Explicit port required (no defaulting).

use_tls.description: True to upgrade the dialed connection to TLS via tlslayer.Client.

sni.description: SNI server name; defaults to target_addr host portion when use_tls=true.

override_bytes.description: Replacement payload interpreted per override_bytes_encoding; mutually exclusive with patches.

override_bytes_set.description: Set true to replace with empty bytes.

patches.description: Offset-based byte patches applied to the base bytes; mutually exclusive with override_bytes. Used as a base for 'patches[N].data' positions.

insecure_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS server certificate verification when use_tls=true.

tag.description: Tag stored on every variant Stream's Tags map.

positions.description: Ordered position list. The cartesian product yields the variant sequence (capped at 1000).

stop_on_error.description: When true, abort the remaining variants once any variant fails (network error, timeout, or pipeline drop).
